title: Perinatal emotional skills groups for women and birthing people with borderline personality disorder: outcomes from a feasibility randomised controlled trial
abstractStartsWith: There is no clear evidence about how to support people with borderline personality disorder (BPD) during the perinatal period.
contains: Perinatal ESGs may represent an effective intervention for perinatal women and birthing people with BPD.
